summary: The PR addresses the issue of preserving the SameSite attribute when deleting cookies, which is important for modern browsers. However, it uses the SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE setting, which may not be appropriate for all cookies.

issues.description: Using SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE for all cookies may not be appropriate, as different cookies might require different SameSite settings. A more flexible approach, such as allowing the SameSite attribute to be specified in the delete_cookie method, would be better.
